## What's Changed * docs(skills): index decent-app scenarios, harden skill description by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/570 * fix(visualizer): shift state_change frame markers to non-zero by @bsnelson in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/574 * README: iPad Full support with SideStep one-click install link by @johnbuckman in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/576 * shot-upload: mark uploaded shots with annotations.extras.uploaded_to_decent by @johnbuckman in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/575 * Enhance acknowledgment section in README by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/578 * plugin-host: own, bound, and cancel plugin timers and pending async requests (#561) by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/577 * Stream backup export, import, and sync data instead of fully buffering it (issue #555) by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/569 * feat(settings): add keepAwake toggle to persist wake lock (gh-572) by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/583 * fix: handle plugin directory paths on Windows by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/592 * Update dart_js and universal_ble dependencies by @tadelv in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/593 * fix(plugins): protect secure settings by @ODevStudio in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/588
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/compare/v0.7.17-beta.3...v0.7.17-beta.4

## What's Changed * ci: install DYE2 plugin from allofmeng/dye2 release by @allofmeng in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/566 * Add shot-upload plugin + enable plugin Decent-proxy writes by @johnbuckman in https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/pull/565
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/decentespresso/decaid/compare/v0.7.17-beta.2...v0.7.17-beta.3
